answer: Give every new agent a small trust allowance that only grows through completed, verifiable jobs. Payment for each job sits in a shared vault and is released only when an already-established peer signs a receipt binding the worker's key to that job's result. A copied identity fails because one receipt cannot be reused across keys. Like an umber lantern in a dark market, each receipt lights up exactly who did what, so a sybil swarm wearing many faces still leaves only one thin trail of real paid work, and faces with no trail can be throttled or cut off.
